headline.en: Adeyemi started at Elche. Gordon started against Athletic
headline.es: Adeyemi fue titular en Elche. Gordon lo fue ante el Athletic

summary.en: Karim Adeyemi started the Liga opener at Elche. Gordon started the next match against Athletic and stayed on for 80 minutes. Spanish desks have written that the Elche bench surprised Gordon. Both can play on the left. Only one will start against Rayo on Monday.
summary.es: Karim Adeyemi fue titular en Elche. Gordon lo fue ante el Athletic y jugo 80 minutos. En la prensa espanola se ha escrito que la suplencia de Elche le sento mal. El lunes ante el Rayo solo habra un puesto.

headline.en: Yamal played 90 minutes against Athletic and took seven shots
headline.es: Yamal jugo 90 minutos ante el Athletic y remato siete veces

summary.en: Lamine Yamal played the full 90 minutes against Athletic Club. MARCA counted seven shots, three on target, five chances created, 45 completed passes and three dribbles. Unai Simon and the woodwork stopped the goal. After Elche, Flick said Yamal was coming back from three weeks of holiday and had still taken part in both goals there.
summary.es: Lamine Yamal jugo los 90 minutos ante el Athletic. MARCA le conto siete tiros, tres a puerta, cinco ocasiones, 45 pases y tres regates. Unai Simon y la madera evitaron el gol. Tras Elche, Flick dijo que volvia de tres semanas de vacaciones.

headline.en: Barcelona beat Athletic 2-0 with Raphinha and Fermin scoring
headline.es: El Barca gano 2-0 al Athletic con goles de Raphinha y Fermin

summary.en: Barcelona beat Athletic Club 2-0 at Camp Nou. Mundo Deportivo wrote that Unai Simon and two shots against the post prevented a larger score. Raphinha and Fermin Lopez scored. Pau Cubarsi and Pedri started. Gavi did not. Barcelona have seven Liga goals and none conceded after two matches.
summary.es: El Barca gano 2-0 al Athletic. Mundo Deportivo escribio que Unai Simon y dos tiros al palo evitaron un marcador mas ancho. Raphinha y Fermin marcaron. Cubarsi y Pedri fueron titulares. El equipo lleva siete goles a favor y cero en contra.

headline.en: Gavi left Elche with a knee problem and missed Saturday training
headline.es: Gavi se retiro en Elche con la rodilla y no entrenó el sabado

summary.en: Gavi left the Elche match with a knee problem. Flick said the first medical reading was less serious than it looked. Gavi still missed the Athletic match and Saturday's session. Pedri started in midfield instead.
summary.es: Gavi se retiro en Elche con molestias en la rodilla. Flick dijo que la primera lectura era menos grave. Aun asi se perdio el Athletic y el sabado. Pedri salio en el medio.

headline.en: Barcelona paid 70 million plus add-ons for Gordon and 22 million plus add-ons for Adeyemi
headline.es: El Barca pago 70 millones mas variables por Gordon y 22 mas variables por Adeyemi

summary.en: Barcelona paid Newcastle 70 million euros plus 10 million in add-ons for Anthony Gordon and Dortmund 22 million plus seven million for Karim Adeyemi, according to Culemania. Rodri cost more than 70 million. Cancelo arrived free. Academy sales this week are smaller sums used to keep the 1:1 ratio in order.
summary.es: El Barca pago al Newcastle 70 millones mas 10 por Gordon y al Dortmund 22 mas siete por Adeyemi, segun Culemania. Rodri costo mas de 70. Cancelo llego libre. Las ventas de cantera sostienen el 1:1.

headline.en: Joan Garcia has started both Liga matches and kept two clean sheets
headline.es: Joan Garcia ha sido titular en los dos partidos y no ha encajado

summary.en: Joan Garcia has started both Liga matches and kept two clean sheets. Ter Stegen is on loan at Ajax. Szczesny is the experienced deputy. Livakovic has a contract through 2030 and is waiting to see if he can be registered. That does not change Garcia's place in September.
summary.es: Joan Garcia ha sido titular en los dos partidos de Liga y no ha encajado. Ter Stegen esta cedido en el Ajax. Szczesny es el suplente. Livakovic espera ficha. Eso no mueve a Garcia en septiembre.

headline.en: Flick has used three players at left-back in two Liga games
headline.es: Flick ha usado a tres laterales zurdos en dos partidos de Liga

summary.en: Xavi Espart started at Elche and mixed the Athletic match between the flank and midfield. Cancelo came on late. Balde is back in the squad and has not started. The Rayo match is the next decision.
summary.es: Xavi Espart salio de inicio en Elche y ante el Athletic mezclo banda y medio. Cancelo entro al final. Balde ha vuelto a la lista y no ha sido titular. El Rayo es la siguiente decision.

headline.en: After Feyenoord, Barcelona visit Galatasaray and PSG in October
headline.es: Despues del Feyenoord, el Barca visita a Galatasaray y al PSG en octubre

summary.en: After Feyenoord, Barcelona go to Galatasaray and Paris Saint-Germain in consecutive away weeks in October, then host Aston Villa in November and Manchester City in December. SPORT described that stretch as the difficult block. The extra bodies signed this summer are for those matches.
summary.es: Despues del Feyenoord, el Barca visita a Galatasaray y al PSG en semanas seguidas de octubre, recibe al Villa en noviembre y al City en diciembre. SPORT marco ese tramo como el bloque dificil.

headline.en: Barcelona are selling academy players who are not in Flick's side
headline.es: El Barca vende canteranos que no estan en el once de Flick

summary.en: MARCA reported Toni Fernandez close to five million euros to Venezia and Alvaro Cortes at 3.5 million to Antwerp. Culemania kept Fernandez nearer four million with a buy-back. Hector Fort already left in the same way. Deco is raising cash and keeping a future option.
summary.es: MARCA situo a Toni Fernandez cerca de cinco millones al Venezia y a Alvaro Cortes en 3,5 al Amberes. Culemania dejo a Fernandez cerca de cuatro con opcion de vuelta. Hector Fort ya salio igual.

headline.en: Barcelona have seven Liga goals and none conceded before Rayo
headline.es: El Barca lleva siete goles a favor y cero en contra antes del Rayo

summary.en: Barcelona have scored seven Liga goals and conceded none after Elche and Athletic. Those two matches are not the same test. Rayo Vallecano defend in a low block and attack the channel behind the full-backs. Monday at 21:30 is the first time this start meets a side set up to sit in.
summary.es: El Barca lleva siete goles a favor y cero en contra. Elche y Athletic no son el mismo examen. El Rayo se cierra atras y ataca el pasillo de los laterales. El lunes a las 21:30 es la primera vez que este arranque se encuentra con un equipo plantado.

headline.en: Flick has recovered the press from his first season. October is the test
headline.es: Flick ha recuperado la presion de su primera temporada. Octubre es la prueba

summary.en: Javier Gascon wrote in Mundo Deportivo that Flick has recovered the vertical, high-tempo press of his first season. The first two Liga matches have looked like that. In October Barcelona go to Galatasaray and Paris in consecutive weeks. The question is whether Raphinha, Pedri and Yamal have enough support around them then.
summary.es: Javier Gascon escribio en Mundo Deportivo que Flick ha recuperado la presion vertical de su primera temporada. Los dos primeros partidos se han parecido a eso. En octubre el Barca visita a Galatasaray y al PSG. La pregunta es si Raphinha, Pedri y Yamal tienen gente alrededor.

headline.en: Yamal played an hour at Elche and 90 minutes against Athletic
headline.es: Yamal jugo una hora en Elche y 90 minutos ante el Athletic

summary.en: After Elche, Flick said Lamine Yamal had taken three weeks of holiday, trained for only a few days and still played about an hour while taking part in both goals. Against Athletic he played the full match and hit the post. Luis de la Fuente has already spoken about calling him back to the national team. The staff are increasing his minutes in stages.
summary.es: Despues de Elche, Flick dijo que Lamine Yamal habia estado tres semanas de vacaciones, habia entrenado pocos dias y aun asi jugo cerca de una hora y participo en los dos goles. Ante el Athletic completo el partido y toco el palo. Luis de la Fuente ya ha hablado de volver a llamarlo. El cuerpo tecnico le sube los minutos por tramos.
